def get(k):
    if k not in store: return -1
    tick += 1
    store[k] = (store[k][0], tick)
    return store[k][0]

def put(k, v):

    tick += 1
    store[k] = (v, tick)

row, col = Counter(), Counter()
for (x, y) in points:
    row[y] += cnt[(x, y)]   # weight duplicates
    col[x] += cnt[(x, y)]
res = 0
for (x, y) in points:
    right = row[y] - cnt[(x, y)]
    up    = col[x] - cnt[(x, y)]
    if right > 0 and up > 0: res += right * up * cnt[(x, y)]
return res
